title: Namo Bharat Train Timings to be Extended Till 11 PM | Route & Schedule Details
description: Great news for commuters! NCRTC plans to extend Namo Bharat train timings until 11:00 PM along the lines of the Delhi Metro. Check out the latest route details, frequency, and new schedules.
body:
There is a major update and some highly positive news for daily commuters traveling along the busy [Delhi-Ghaziabad-Meerut](https://metroguideindia.com/namo-bharat/) corridor. To handle the rapidly growing number of passengers relying on this modern transit system, the National Capital Region Transport Corporation (NCRTC) is actively considering extending the daily operational hours of the **namo bharat rapid rail**.

If you frequently travel late at night for work, studies, or business, this upcoming schedule change will make your daily commute much easier.

## Timings to be Extended on the Lines of Namo Bharat Metro

According to the official **namo bharat train timings**, the modern high-speed trains currently operate from **6:00 AM to 10:00 PM**. Under the existing schedule, the first train departs simultaneously from both terminal ends, [Sarai Kale Khan](https://metroguideindia.com/namo-bharat/stations/sarai-kale-khan.html) in Delhi and [Modipuram ](https://metroguideindia.com/namo-bharat/stations/modipuram.html)in Meerut, at 6:00 AM. Meanwhile, the **namo bharat last train** departs for its final destination at 10:00 PM.

To improve passenger convenience and provide a seamless travel experience, the NCRTC is planning to align the **namo bharat timings** with the Delhi Metro network. The management is deliberating a plan to stretch the working hours by one full hour, allowing trains to run until **11:00 PM**.

Once this plan is approved and implemented, the **namo bharat last train** from both Sarai Kale Khan and Modipuram will depart at 11:00 PM instead of 10:00 PM. This extended window will primarily benefit:

- College and university students attending evening or late-night classes.
- Corporate professionals and office-goers returning late from night shifts.
- Business owners, market traders, and laborers working late in commercial hubs.

## 18 Additional Trips Introduced to Handle Passenger Load

The demand for the **rrts delhi** to Meerut transit corridor has skyrocketed in recent months. To successfully handle this rising ridership, the NCRTC recently upgraded its daily operations.

Previously, a total of 192 trips were made daily by trains running from both ends. To manage the immense passenger rush, **18 additional trips** have been integrated into the daily schedule. With this upgrade, a total of **210 trips** are now successfully operated every single day.

According to a senior NCRTC official, passenger footfall is rising steadily, and commuters have been actively requesting an extension of operating hours. In response to this public demand, high-level management discussions are underway. The official shared that a formal announcement regarding the new extended timings is expected to be made very soon.

## At a Glance: Namo Bharat Route & Operational Details

The **namo bharat train route** (also referred to by commuters as the **namo bharat metro route**) covers a massive distance, linking important hubs across Delhi, [Ghaziabad](https://metroguideindia.com/namo-bharat/stations/ghaziabad.html), and Meerut. Below is a quick summary of the key highlights of the operational corridor:

| **Feature** | **Details & Specifications** |
| **Total Route Length** | 82.5 Kilometers |
| **Travel Duration** | Covers the full journey in just 55 to 60 minutes |
| **Current Train Timings** | 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM |
| **Proposed New Timings** | 6:00 AM to 11:00 PM (Extension under review) |
| **Train Frequency** | A train is available every 10 minutes |
| **Total Daily Trips** | 210 trips (18 additional trips added recently) |
| **Major Terminal Hubs** | Sarai Kale Khan (Delhi) to Modipuram (**meerut rrts**) |

## FAQs Related to Namo Bharat Rapid Rail

## 

### Q1: What are the current namo bharat train timings? 

Currently, the trains operate from 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM every day. The first train starts at 6:00 AM, and the last train departs at 10:00 PM from both ends of the corridor.

### **Q2: What is the proposed change for the namo bharat last train?** 

The NCRTC is planning to extend the operational hours by one hour. Under the proposed plan, the last train from both Sarai Kale Khan and Modipuram will depart at 11:00 PM.

### **Q3: Which major cities are connected by the namo bharat train route?** 

The high-speed **namo bharat rapid rail** connects Delhi, Ghaziabad, and Meerut. It spans a total distance of 82.5 km, seamlessly linking the National Capital to major hubs in western Uttar Pradesh.

### **Q4: How much time does it take to travel from Delhi to Meerut via RRTS?** 

Thanks to the high operating speed of the rapid rail, the entire 82.5 km distance between Sarai Kale Khan and Modipuram is covered in just 55 to 60 minutes.

### **Q5: What is the frequency of trains on the namo bharat metro route?** 

Commuters do not have to wait long, as a train is available on the platforms every 10 minutes.

### Q6: Why did NCRTC add 18 additional daily trips? 

Due to a massive surge in daily ridership on the **meerut rrts** and **rrts delhi** network, 18 additional trips were introduced to prevent overcrowding, bringing the total number of daily trips up to 210.
